subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Should Feishu direct-message session maintenance protect active direct sessions, and should malformed Feishu `open_id` direct-session keys be rejected, repaired by doctor, or migrated?
rationale: The fix changes persisted session continuity, store growth behavior, and multi-account Feishu identity handling, so automation should not pick the retention or migration policy alone.

options.title: TTL-aware direct-session protection plus doctor repair
options.body: Protect recent direct Feishu sessions from maintenance, reject or repair malformed `ou_` peer ids through Feishu-owned doctor logic, and prove the upgrade with regression tests plus live or sanitized Feishu evidence.

options.title: Blanket-protect direct sessions
options.body: Make all direct sessions protected maintenance entries, maximizing continuity while accepting larger session stores for transient DM users.

options.title: Keep workaround only
options.body: Continue documenting `per-account-channel-peer` and manual cleanup while leaving direct-DM pruning and malformed-key rebuilds possible.

recommendation.title: TTL-aware direct-session protection plus doctor repair
recommendation.body: Protect recent direct Feishu sessions from maintenance, reject or repair malformed `ou_` peer ids through Feishu-owned doctor logic, and prove the upgrade with regression tests plus live or sanitized Feishu evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved behavior is Feishu-specific identity and doctor repair policy, and the Feishu plugin metadata points to @m1heng as the clearest owner signal.
